title: Fatality inquiry will investigate death of break-in suspect
article: A fatality inquiry will be held into the death of Richard Perry Bellerose who died after he was arrested by city police for breaking into a Forest Heights home on the weekend.

Alberta Justice spokesman Bart Johnson said because Bellerose was in police custody there will be an automatic fatality inquiry. A fatality inquiry can't assign blame in a death but can recommend how to prevent similar deaths.
The medical examiner did an autopsy Monday on Bellerose's body but findings weren't released.
It was about 2:45 a.m. Saturday when playwright Marty Chan and his wife, Michelle, woke after hearing a crash in the main floor of their home near 106th Avenue and 75th Street.

His wife saw the intruder and screamed. Chan ran outside and tackled Bellerose. After a couple of minutes of struggling, police arrived and arrested Bellerose, who began showing signs of physical distress after the arrest. He was rushed to hospital where he was pronounced dead.
